headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: PAT increased 16% YoY/9% QoQ to Rs3.08bn (20% YoY excluding ESOP costs).
Other mortgages contributed 26% of disbursements, with management targeting ~28% by Q4FY27.

Stage 2 assets stood at Rs9.56bn, with Stage 3 PCR at 34.5% and total ECL coverage at 1.2%; management targets GNPA of 1.10–1.15% and credit cost of 25bps by year-end.  Outlook: Management retained guidance of 18–20% disbursement growth and 20% AUM/PAT growth (excluding ESOP costs), with at least 20% disbursement growth in H2.

Management sees opportunity in Tier 2, Tier 3 and smaller emerging markets.  Competition is increasing, making new catchments, productivity and customer retention more important.  RBI raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.5% and shifted to calibrated tightening.
